title: fuzz_raw input
description: Input schema for the fuzz_raw tool (RFC-001 N8 typed raw fuzzer).

flow_id.description: Recorded raw stream id; OPTIONAL — when empty, override_bytes or a 'payload' position must supply the variant bytes.

target_addr.description: Upstream host:port. REQUIRED. Explicit port required (no defaulting).

use_tls.description: True to upgrade the dialed connection to TLS via tlslayer.Client.

sni.description: SNI server name; defaults to target_addr host portion when use_tls=true.

override_bytes.description: Replacement payload interpreted per override_bytes_encoding; mutually exclusive with patches.

override_bytes_set.description: Set true to replace with empty bytes.

patches.description: Offset-based byte patches applied to the base bytes; mutually exclusive with override_bytes. Used as a base for 'patches[N].data' positions.

insecure_skip_verify.description: Skip TLS server certificate verification when use_tls=true.

tag.description: Tag stored on every variant Stream's Tags map.

positions.description: Ordered position list. The cartesian product yields the variant sequence (capped at 1000).

stop_on_error.description: When true, abort the remaining variants once any variant fails (network error, timeout, or pipeline drop).

pre_macro.description: Pre macro hook executed before a variant's dial (scope=iteration) or before the variant loop starts (scope=job). The hook macro shares the KV Store with the variant so extracts flow into §var§ template expansion. For scope=job + on_error=skip, the whole job short-circuits with completed_variants=0 and stopped_reason set. Raw-specific: run_interval='on_status' is REJECTED at validation because raw has no L7 status concept.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once outside the variant loop; KV Store is shared across the whole job).

on_error.description: skip (default; iteration scope skips the variant, job scope skips the whole job) | abort (aborts the whole fuzz run) | continue (record the error and proceed).

vars.description: Static kvStore overrides injected before the macro runs. Keys with the '__' reserved prefix are silently dropped at injection time so a Vars entry cannot shadow runtime-populated reserved keys (__iteration, __nonce, __response_*).

run_interval.description: Hook firing cadence — scope=iteration only. For pre_macro: always (default) | once | every_n | on_error. Rejected with an error when scope='job' or run_interval='on_status' (raw has no L7 status).

n.description: Iteration cadence for pre_macro run_interval='every_n'. Required when run_interval='every_n'.

status_codes.description: Reserved for post_macro on HTTP-style tools. fuzz_raw rejects run_interval='on_status' (raw has no L7 status), so this field has no effect.

match_pattern.description: Response body regex pattern for post_macro run_interval='on_match'. fuzz_raw's __response_body is the matched byte buffer.

post_macro.description: Post macro hook executed after a variant's receive loop completes (scope=iteration) or after the variant loop completes (scope=job). For scope=iteration, raw-specific reserved keys are injected: __response_body (received bytes, 64 KiB cap), __response_chunks, __response_truncated. NOT injected: __response_status, __response_headers* (raw has no L7 status concept — MITM principle: do not invent hypothetical surface). For scope=job, no per-iteration response is injected. Raw-specific: run_interval='on_status' is REJECTED at validation; use run_interval='on_match' against __response_body bytes.

name.description: Stored macro name (defined via the macro tool's define_macro action).

scope.description: iteration (default; fires once per variant) | job (fires once after the variant loop completes).

on_error.description: skip (default; log warn + record error row) | abort (post failures never abort the run; behaviour matches skip for post) | continue (same as skip).

vars.description: Static kvStore overrides injected before the macro runs. Keys with the '__' reserved prefix are silently dropped at injection time.

run_interval.description: Hook firing cadence — scope=iteration only. For post_macro: always (default) | on_match. on_status is REJECTED for fuzz_raw (raw has no L7 status; use on_match against __response_body).

n.description: Reserved for pre_macro run_interval='every_n'. post_macro does NOT accept every_n.

status_codes.description: Rejected on fuzz_raw — raw has no L7 status concept.

match_pattern.description: Response body regex pattern for post_macro run_interval='on_match'. Required when run_interval='on_match'. The matched buffer is __response_body (received bytes, 64 KiB cap).
